assumptions.statement: The site and three key areas use maintainer-provided provisional rough polygons.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas, ratios, drawings and spatial relationships must be regenerated after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks and regulatory lines are not available.
assumptions.impact: Land use, height, massing and intensity remain concept guidance rather than approved controls.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, uses, age, structure and ownership are not available in a cleared baseline.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints are spatial prototypes; no parcel-level retain, renovate or demolish decision is made.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, station interfaces, traffic counts and parking baselines are absent.
assumptions.impact: Roads express walking/cycling connection intent only and are not engineering alignments.

assumptions.statement: No-App means a non-digital basic-service baseline plus optional digital enhancement and human assistance; it does not ban apps.
assumptions.impact: Each scenario must preserve access without mandatory registration, smartphone ownership or facial recognition.

assumptions.statement: Events, pilots, service operators, procurement and funding have not been committed.
assumptions.impact: Phasing and operation are reference mechanisms subject to authorization, budget, staffing and public review.

assumptions.statement: Accessibility, privacy, cybersecurity, safety and human-review procedures require specialist and user testing.
assumptions.impact: The proposal states acceptance gates but does not certify legal or technical compliance.
